Define a line style

Source: R/style.R
line_style.Rd

Used for rules, dividers, borders and legend keys.

Usage

line_style(color = "rule_light", lwd = 0.75, lty = "solid", alpha = NULL)

Arguments

color

Line colour: an R colour or a theme colour name. `NA` hides the line.

lwd

Line width in grid `lwd` units (1 = 1/96 inch).

lty

Line type.

alpha

Optional opacity (0-1) applied to `color`.

Value

A `bb_line_style` object.

Examples

line_style("rule_light", lwd = 0.75)
#> $color
#> [1] "rule_light"
#> 
#> $lwd
#> [1] 0.75
#> 
#> $lty
#> [1] "solid"
#> 
#> $alpha
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_line_style"
